shared_elements: low-relief carving worked into the stone surface
horizontal band or ridge crossing the shaft
justification: Both are tall upright stone blocks bearing shallow, rounded low-relief motifs organised on a broad vertical face, with a horizontal band or ridge crossing the shaft, which gives a broadly similar first impression. But the subject matter and handling differ sharply: A is an anthropomorphic figure carved in the round with a head, shoulders and symmetrical abstract/disc motifs on a dark stone, while B is a flat pale slab bearing an outlined quadruped in profile and other animal-like forms with no figural body shape.
